app.title: Bundle Tool Suite
app.subtitle: Turn an App Bundle into installable packages, sign your APKs.
drop.aab.title: Drop your AAB file here
drop.apk.title: Drop the APK to sign here
drop.wrong_ext: That isn't a {ext} file. Pick a file with the right extension.
valid.title: {count} fields left before you can start
valid.body: Without the keystore file and its password the package can't be signed. Fill in the marked fields.
valid.ks_pass: Password is empty — the keystore can't be opened.
valid.pass_file: Pick a TXT file that contains the password.
done.title: Package ready — {duration}
log.title: Output log
err.ks_password.title: Wrong keystore password
err.ks_password.body: The keystore password you entered doesn't open this file.
err.ks_password.action: Check the password; if you read it from a TXT file it must be a single line with no spaces.
err.alias_missing.title: That alias isn't in the keystore
err.alias_missing.body: The key name inside the keystore looks different.
err.alias_missing.action: Clear the alias field and try again — I'll list the available aliases.
err.java_missing.title: Java not found
err.java_missing.body: This tool needs Java 17 and I couldn't find it on your system.
err.permission.title: No write access to that folder
err.permission.body: I can't write to the output folder you picked.
err.permission.action: Try a folder on your Desktop.
err.file_missing.title: File not found
err.file_missing.body: The file you picked has been moved or deleted.
err.not_a_bundle.title: This file isn't an App Bundle
err.not_a_bundle.body: The file is corrupt or not a .aab.
err.not_a_bundle.action: Pick the .aab you downloaded from Play Console.
err.zipalign.title: Alignment failed
err.zipalign.body: The APK was signed but zipalign failed. The signed file is in your output folder.
err.zipalign.action: You can turn zipalign off and try again.
err.disk_full.title: Out of disk space
err.disk_full.body: The disk filled up while writing the output.
err.disk_full.action: Free some space and try again.
err.sdk_missing.title: Android SDK tools missing
err.sdk_missing.body: apksigner or zipalign couldn't be found.
err.sdk_missing.action: Point to your Android SDK build-tools folder in settings.
err.unknown.title: Couldn't finish
err.unknown.action: Copy the details and share them so we can work out why.
